purpose: Re-measure Oracle non-indexed TPC-C alone (the first run overlapped the after-phase-F vault snapshot)

steps.command: source <campaign>/code/rc_env.sh oracle tpcc && cd $RC_CAMPAIGN/src && taskset -c 2,3 $RC_PY $RC_CAMPAIGN/code/rc_fingerprint.py --dbms oracle --benchmark tpcc --label oracle-tpcc-C-after-r2 --out $RC_CAMPAIGN/evidence/fingerprints/oracle-tpcc-C-after-r2.json && python3 -c "import json;a=json.load(open('$RC_CAMPAIGN/evidence/fingerprints/oracle-tpcc-C-before-r2.json'))['content_sha256'];b=json.load(open('$RC_CAMPAIGN/evidence/fingerprints/oracle-tpcc-C-after-r2.json'))['content_sha256'];print('before',a,'after',b);assert a==b"

source <campaign>/code/rc_env.sh oracle tpcc && cd $RC_CAMPAIGN/src && out=$(taskset -c 2,3 $RC_PY scripts/1-setup/manage_indexes.py --database default --benchmark tpcc --action create 2>&1); echo "$out"; echo "$out" | grep -q 'Summary: .* 0 failed'
